author: Gatorman2024
title: POKÉMON GO: PAY MORE, GET LESS! AVOID THIS HEADACHE OF A GAME!
content:
This app has become one of the most frustrating games I have ever spent money on, and at this point I genuinely want my money back.

Pokémon GO increasingly feels less like a game designed to reward players and more like a system designed to convince players to keep spending money.

The GO Battle League is a perfect example. You play five battles in a set, but your rewards are heavily dependent on how many you win. You can spend your time battling for an entire set, lose a couple of matches, and suddenly the rewards you were working toward are out of reach. Losing is already part of competitive gaming, but Pokémon GO makes losing feel unnecessarily punishing. A few bad matchups or unlucky battles can make an entire session feel worthless.

Then there are raids, which are arguably even more frustrating.

You can spend real money on a Raid Pass or Remote Raid Pass, put together a full lobby of players, enter the raid, and STILL fail to defeat the Raid Boss.

Think about that. You can have a full group of people who all spent time getting into the raid, use a paid pass, battle the boss, and still lose because the Pokémon is so difficult to defeat. Now you have potentially wasted your pass, your time, and the opportunity to catch the Pokémon  and if you want to try again, you may have to spend more money.

And even when you DO successfully defeat the Raid Boss, you still are not guaranteed to catch it.

You can spend money on the pass, successfully defeat the boss, use every Premier Ball you’re given, use Golden Razz Berries, make Great or Excellent throws, and still watch the Pokémon escape every single time.

That is an incredibly frustrating experience for something that can require real money.

I understand that Pokémon GO is built around chance and that catching a Raid Boss is not supposed to be guaranteed. But there needs to be a better balance when players are spending actual money to participate.

The amount of monetization in this game has also gotten ridiculous. Raid Passes, Remote Raid Passes, Premium Battle Passes, incubators, event tickets, PokéCoins, storage upgrades, boxes, and countless other purchases constantly give players reasons to spend more.

I have no problem spending money on a game when I feel like I’m getting reasonable value in return.

What I have a problem with is repeatedly paying money and being given no reasonable assurance that my time, effort, or purchase will actually result in anything.

The most frustrating part is that I actually WANT to enjoy this game. I have invested a huge amount of time and money into Pokémon GO because I love Pokémon. That makes it even more disappointing when the game makes the experience feel like a constant grind with increasingly aggressive monetization.

Niantic needs to seriously rethink the way raids, Battle League rewards, paid passes, and player compensation work.

Players should not have to feel like they are constantly throwing money at a game just for the POSSIBILITY of getting what they wanted.

At this point, I am extremely disappointed with Pokémon GO, and after everything I have spent on this game, I genuinely want my money back.

Respect players’ time. Respect their effort. And most importantly, respect their money.

author: touchdown_
title: GBL sucks but good game
content:
i enjoy the game a lot now that ive gotten it to work. the core game is very fun, despite the people writing reviews saying the game is pay to play now blah blah. i just came back to this game and im surprised how easily im able to play the game as f2p. i even spent some money because i think its rare for gaming companies to not force microtransactions on you and i want to support their decision to keep the game fun for free players. my biggest issue is the battle league though. before i get into it i should mention ive reached legend before my hiatus. if the game had normal battles i would give it 5 stars. however, the current system is horrible. i understand the whole getting people to grind thing by making 5 star raid bosses have ~5% chance from GBL encounters but when a (possible) reward like that is stuck behind one of the worst pvp modes in gaming its a bit upsetting. battles consist of tapping the screen quickly so your pokemon can attack as quickly as possible (which also just makes your pokemon look goofy by animation cancelling the attack every time). they decided to incorporate the worst parts of turn-based games to pvp. if you use a move at the same time as your opponent and they end up getting the attack off first, youre forced to use energy on a charged move. if the opponents pokemon is low hp and you were just trying to beat them to the charged attack so you didnt have to take their next one, youre SOL. your charged move will go through after theirs making you waste your charge on a low hp pokemon that wouldve died to fast attacks at that point. i cant count how many times ive lost because of this bs mechanic. not to mention the game is so fast paced that your opponent might be counting your fast attacks so they can switch to a favorable matchup right when you use your charged attack. as it stands, pvp is an absolute wreck and encourages scummy playstyles. why even have "turns" at that point. scopely or whoever runs this game now need to realize they should cut their losses and make pvp more traditional. i would say the department in charge of pvp needs to be fired and replaced but i know there isnt one so im complaining to people that dont exist. wish i could give this game 5 stars but the pvp is too terrible for me to ignore as someone who primarily plays pvp games.
 Edit: lowering to 3 because they doubled down on the garbage pvp while lowering startdust reward for 1 win this season. i also spent money on remote pass and excellent golden razz curveball every throw and i end up running out of balls because zamazenta just doesnt stay in the ball i guess. scummy predatory practice. considering chargeback

How do you expect me to play a game where the battle league is soley dependent on only a small handful of pokemon. 1500 play mimiku and lickylicky and you win 99% of the time.
2500 get ready for nothing but skeledurge and spammy gyrados.
No Limit is a joke, i wouldnt bother. 
Also the whole “elite charge tm” being held by only certain levels or paywalls when most other brand games arent pay to win is SOO scummy. Like the collecting Pokemon part and walking to earn become irrelevant if you just buy remote passes. Aswell as its just borderline unfair when the game has this AWFUL trade system thats overly dependent on you needing to be max friend or next to them at all times. Defeats the purpose of making friends from a distance. Not to mention anything stardust based, like the candies is already enough PLUS mega candies. I just truly wish the game can feel more like collecting your fav mon and going on ARG adventures and training them like the main franchise games. So much wasted potential.

author: dstoneh
title: Another game ruined by scopely
content: This game was great! Updated frequently, a huge community, tons of events. And it was free! The occasional paid event or thing in the shop, but easy to play for free, with no real incentive to spend extra money than “because.” Scopely changed that. Many elements of PoGo have already been nerfed since their acquisition over Niantic. And as many players in the community can see, it is rapidly progressing towards a Pay to Win Model filled to the brim with micro-transactions that they are trying as hard as possible to get you to pay. Goodbye PoGo. Yet another mobile game ruined by Scopely
